text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after finishing training as usual 
with Mejiro Ryan—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
choice_data_list: You can hear it... hear what?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Pectorals, trapezius, quadriceps... No, 
every single muscle in my body is 
screaming!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This is still nowhere near enough... I 
know I can go much, much further!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, the throbbing just won't stop...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems Mejiro Ryan still wants to 
keep training.
choice_data_list:
Maybe they're screaming because they want 
to rest...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The cries of my muscles... With my own 
hands, I'll conduct them into an 
orchestra!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The virtuoso conductor of muscles, Mejiro 
Ryan. It seemed she worked up a great 
sweat during her extra training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, that's certainly one way to look 
at it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. It seems I haven't been 
having enough conversations with my 
muscles yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Can everyone hear me? Let's take 
today off, okayー!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan conversed with her muscles. 
After their conference, it seemed she 
decided to take a rest for the day.
